verifiedScope.proxy: Culture-novel first-book-publication span, from Consider Phlebas to The Hydrogen Sonata, used as a publishing proxy rather than a full-career span or a claim of uninterrupted writing. The eight selected markers use original English-language book years, not composition, serialization, later national editions, translations or the Culture’s internal chronology. Some early science-fiction drafts predate his 1984 debut as Iain Banks; that does not move these publication dates. The State of the Art short-fiction collection (1991), non-Culture science fiction and his other novels are outside this scoped bar. Poetry, nonfiction and posthumous releases—including The Culture: The Drawings (2023)—are also excluded.
